what: 2026 link model (app/detectors/link_2026.py): character pieces of the whole link, logistic regression
data: urlscan.io collection on this PC (OpenPhish / PhishTank phishing + real sites' pages, Sep-Oct 2026) + Chrome UX Report real 2026 sites

split.test: 2026-10-14 and later, sites never seen in training + another 25% of the real sites

level_rule: alert: only 0.5% of each kind of real calibration link reaches it (raises the score); verify: 5% (a note only)
keep_rule: kept only if the whole engine's AUC and catch rate rise, with at most 1 point more real links flagged AND at most 1 point more real free-hosted sites flagged, and plain personal projects (my-portfolio.vercel.app ...) stay below 51
